body: Note: `sd_size` (number of glyphs) and `bidi_run_end - bidi_run_start` (number of characters) are different types of values, but in case of `reserve` it is fine as rough approximation, glyph count usually is close to character count.

This seems to be processing all fonts in the same way, but first font in the span should be always first in the priority list (script/language support is not 100% reliable and completely missing for bitmap fonts, so we want to try user specified font first regardless of support flags).
Oop, missed these suggestions; we can handle these in a style pass instead
